start.name_zh: 泗洪分输站（干线分输站，归仁镇一带）
start.name_en: Sihong Distribution Station (branches off the main trunk), near Guiren Town, Sihong County, Suqian, Jiangsu
start.geocode_source: Nominatim q='归仁镇 泗洪县' (township centroid). GEM's own StartLocation field ('Sihong County Panshan Villege') was cross-checked by a separate place-name search for '潘山村' (Panshan Village), which resolves to 归仁镇 (Guiren Town), Sihong County — but no source found in this research ties the 泗洪分输站 facility itself to that specific village/township at that precision (see blockers). County-level (泗洪县) is the level actually confirmed by the branch-line sources.

end.name_en: Sihong End/Terminal Station, Sihong County, Suqian, Jiangsu
end.geocode_source: Nominatim q='泗洪县 宿迁' (county centroid fallback; a direct search for '泗洪末站' returned unrelated Nanchang bus-stop features, so county level is the finest resolvable in OSM)

corridor_notes: Sihong branch line (泗洪支干线) of the 苏皖豫干线 project, entirely within Suqian City (Sihong County), Jiangsu. Per the MEE Nov-2025 EIA approval: '支干线起自干线泗洪分输站，止于江苏省宿迁市泗洪末站，长26.62公里' (starts at Sihong Distribution Station on the main trunk, ends at Sihong End Station, Suqian; 26.62 km, DN323.9mm). PipeChina's own EIA public-participation notice and GEM both give 28.5 km for this segment (pre-final-design figure).
researcher_notes: The branch's existence, start facility (泗洪分输站) and end facility (泗洪末站) are confirmed by two independent official sources with identical wording. GEM's pre-existing StartLocation field ('Sihong County Panshan Villege') plausibly refers to 潘山村 in 归仁镇 (Guiren Town) by romanization match, but I could not independently corroborate that the 泗洪分输站 facility sits in/near that specific village — treat the township-level start coordinate as a reasonable but unconfirmed refinement, not a source-verified fact.
blockers: Could not find any source tying 泗洪分输站 to 潘山村/归仁镇 specifically (searched '泗洪分输站 归仁镇' directly, no hits) — the village/township identification rests on name-matching against GEM's own prior field, not an independent citation. Neither station resolves directly in OSM/Nominatim.
